purpose: Check whether WISE 0855 shows up when D6 exposures are stacked, independently of the app's engines.
script: not versioned; the method below is complete enough to reproduce

data.why_not_43: IRSA's cutout service kept answering 503 'Server busy'; the download was stopped at 22 files

method: cutout 0.1 deg around the position propagated to 2026.0 with SIMBAD proper motion
IMAGE minus ZODI, then minus the frame median
mask pixels with FLAGS bits 0,2,6,7,9,10,11,15,17,26,27,28,29; SOURCE (21) is NOT masked
reproject_interp onto a common TAN grid (6.15 arcsec/px), inverse-variance weighted mean
follow: each frame shifted by the predicted proper-motion displacement; fixed: no shift
aperture radius 1.5 px; null = the same aperture at 400 random positions at least 9 px from the target

interpretation.verdict: suggestive, not a confirmed detection; formal errors underestimate the noise by x1.4-1.9
interpretation.caveat: the robust z-score (about 9) is not reliable: the background has real stars, so its tail is not Gaussian; use the empirical rank
